CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructAppend

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Adds every key and value of the second structure to the first. The first structure is changed in place; the second is left alone.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructAppend(struct1, struct2 [, overwriteFlag ])

Parameters

struct1
The structure that receives the keys.
struct2
The structure whose keys are copied.
overwriteFlag
YES (the default): keys that already exist in struct1 get the value from struct2. NO: existing keys in struct1 keep their values.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

A handy way to apply defaults: append a structure of default settings with overwriteFlag NO, and only the settings the user did not choose are filled in.

Values that are themselves structures are copied by reference, the same as StructCopy.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Prefs = StructNew()>
<CFSET Prefs.Color = "Teal">
<CFSET Defaults = StructNew()>
<CFSET Defaults.Color = "Gray">
<CFSET Defaults.Font = "Arial">
<CFSET Defaults.Modem = "56K">

<CFSET Temp = StructAppend(Prefs, Defaults, "No")>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Key</TH><TH>Value</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="#StructKeyList(Prefs)#" INDEX="Key">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#Key#</TD><TD>#Prefs[Key]#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

StructInsert, StructCopy, StructUpdate, Duplicate
